questions.problem:
Find the missing values in the following truth table:

| $\,A\,$ | $\,B\,$ | $\,¬(A∧¬B)\,$ | $\,¬A∨B\,$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ | {{field-1}} | $\text{T}$ |
| $\text{T}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ | {{field-2}} |
| $\text{F}$ | $\text{T}$ | {{field-3}} | $\text{T}$ |
| $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ |

Using your results, complete the following statement:

$$
¬(A∧¬B){{field-4}}¬A∨B
$$
questions.worked_solution:
First, let's solve for the missing values:

- When $A≡\text{T}$ and $B≡\text{T},$ we have

$$
\begin{aligned}¬(A∧¬B) & ≡¬(\text{T}∧¬\text{T}) \\  & ≡¬(\text{T}∧\text{F}) \\  & ≡¬\text{F} \\  & ≡\text{T}\end{aligned}
$$

- When $A≡\text{T}$ and $B≡\text{F},$ we have

$$
\begin{aligned}¬A∨B & ≡¬\text{T}∨\text{F} \\  & ≡\text{F}∨\text{F} \\  & ≡\text{F}\end{aligned}
$$

- When $A≡\text{F}$ and $B≡\text{T},$ we have

$$
\begin{aligned}¬(A∧¬B) & ≡¬(\text{F}∧¬\text{T}) \\  & ≡¬(\text{F}∧\text{F}) \\  & ≡¬\text{F} \\  & ≡\text{T}\end{aligned}
$$

Our completed table is shown below. 

| $\,A\,$ | $\,B\,$ | $\,¬(A∧¬B)\,$ | $\,¬A∨B\,$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ |
| $\text{T}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ |
| $\text{F}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ |
| $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ |

To determine whether $¬(A∧¬B)$ is logically equivalent to $¬A∨B,$ we need to check whether their truth tables are equivalent.

Looking at the last two columns, we see that they are the same $(\text{T},\text{F},\text{T},\text{T}).$ Therefore, we conclude that 

$$
¬(A∧¬B)≡¬A∨B.
$$

$$

$$

canonical_examples.problem:
Find the missing values in the following truth table:

| $\,A\,$ | $\,B\,$ | $\,\neg A \land \neg B \,$ | $\,\neg (A \lor B) \,$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $\textrm T$ | $\textrm T$ | $\textrm F$ | $\textrm F$ |
| $\textrm T$ | $\textrm F$ | $\bbox[2pt,Gainsboro]{\color{blue}\phantom{F}}$ | $\textrm F$ |
| $\textrm F$ | $\textrm T$ | $\textrm F$ | $\bbox[2pt,Gainsboro]{\color{blue}\phantom{F}}$ |
| $\textrm F$ | $\textrm F$ | $\textrm T$ | $\bbox[2pt,Gainsboro]{\color{blue}\phantom{F}}$ |

Use your results to determine whether $\neg A \land \neg B$ is logically equivalent to $\neg (A \lor B).$
canonical_examples.worked_solution:
First, let's solve for the missing values:

- When $A \equiv \textrm T$ and $B \equiv \textrm F,$ we have

$$
\begin{aligned}¬A∧¬B & ≡¬\text{T}∧¬\text{F} \\  & ≡\text{F}∧\text{T} \\  & ≡\text{F}\end{aligned}
$$

- When $A \equiv \textrm F$ and $B \equiv \textrm T,$ we have

$$
\begin{aligned}¬(A∨B) & ≡¬(\text{F}∨\text{T}) \\  & ≡¬\text{T} \\  & ≡\text{F}\end{aligned}
$$

- When $A \equiv \textrm F$ and $B \equiv \textrm F,$ we have

$$
\begin{aligned}¬(A∨B) & ≡¬(\text{F}∨\text{F}) \\  & ≡¬\text{F} \\  & ≡\text{T}\end{aligned}
$$

Our completed table is shown below.

| $\,A\,$ | $\,B\,$ | $\,\neg A \land \neg B \,$ | $\,\neg (A \lor B) \,$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $\textrm T$ | $\textrm T$ | $\textrm F$ | $\textrm F$ |
| $\textrm T$ | $\textrm F$ | $\bbox[2pt,Gainsboro]{\color{blue}\textrm F}$ | $\textrm F$ |
| $\textrm F$ | $\textrm T$ | $\textrm F$ | $\bbox[2pt,Gainsboro]{\color{blue}\textrm F}$ |
| $\textrm F$ | $\textrm F$ | $\textrm T$ | $\bbox[2pt,Gainsboro]{\color{blue}\textrm T}$ |

 

To determine whether $\neg A \land \neg B$ is logically equivalent to $\neg (A \lor B),$ we need to check whether their truth tables are equivalent.

Looking at the last two columns, we see that they are the same $(\textrm{F},\textrm{F},\textrm{F},\textrm{T}).$ Therefore, we conclude that $\neg A \land \neg B$ is logically equivalent to $\neg (A \lor B),$ that is,

$$
\neg A \land \neg B \bbox[2pt,Gainsboro]{\color{blue}\equiv} \neg (A \lor B).
$$
